name: rainbow-border
title: Rainbow Border
description: A thin border made of a turning colour wheel around a card or button. It turns while you point at or focus the element and rests otherwise.

meta.useWhen: One element that is literally about colour (a paint, a print shop, a palette tool, a pride event), or the single "new" item in a list.
meta.avoidWhen: As generic "AI glow"; on more than one element per screen; serious or quiet brands; around body text blocks.
